info.title: Immons.Tools.Maui.Inspector.Sync
info.description: XAML Updater — companion dotnet tool for Immons.Tools.Maui.Inspector: watches the in-app inspector for live property edits and writes them back into your XAML source files (WYSIWYG loop, pairs with IDE XAML Hot Reload).

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: XAML Updater (maui-inspector-sync) — writes live MauiInspector edits back into your XAML sources.
x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Typical use: cd into your app's source folder and just run

options.name: --app
options.description: Base URL of the running app's web inspector (skips scanning).

options.name: --src
options.description: Root folder that contains the XAML sources (searched recursively).

options.name: --from-now
options.description: Ignore edits made before the updater started.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would change without writing files.
